releases.notes:
This release is directly implemented from the MC-1.15.2 release and made compatible with MC-1.16.1.

Added Features:
-HUD Fading Animation: HUD will fade in and out when a session is activated or deactivated.
-Load/Save Gui Multi-selection: Able to select multiple recordings for faster deletion of multiple records.
-Playback Starts With Smooth Transition: Player will smoothy transition into the starting position when in range.
-Playback Fail Detection: Playback detects when the player is unable to follow the prerecorded path and will automatically stop.

Bug Fixes:
-Playback triggers anti-cheat in a multiplayer server too often.
-Arrow particle causes clouds to lose depth.
-Load/Save Gui naming box's text field won't focus after first use.
-Game crashes in Load/Save Gui when deselecting all selected recordings.
-Overriding session doesn't seamlessly transition into itself from previous recording.

mods.description: A Minecraft mod that allows you to record and playback parkour sessions.

releases.notes:
Added Features:
-HUD Fading Animation: HUD will fade in and out when a session is activated or deactivated.
-Load/Save Gui Multi-selection: Able to select multiple recordings for faster deletion of multiple records.
-Playback Starts With Smooth Transition: Player will smoothy transition into the starting position when in range.
-Playback Fail Detection: Playback detects when the player is unable to follow the prerecorded path and will automatically stop.

Bug Fixes:
-Playback triggers anti-cheat in a multiplayer server too often.
-Arrow particle causes clouds to lose depth.
-Load/Save Gui naming box's text field won't focus after first use.
-Game crashes in Load/Save Gui when deselecting all selected recordings.
-Overriding session doesn't seamlessly transition into itself from previous recording.

Session based API to better organize code for recording and playback sessions.

Added Features:
-Session Based API: Recording and playback sessions will now be handled separately.
-Record History: All recordings will be cached to history for future playback or for saving.
-Save Recording GUI: Shows record history and allows you to name and save a recording among other features.
-Cooler Particle Animations: Particle markers' spawn animations for when a new playback session is created.

Bug Fixes:
-Sudden game crash after having a playback session waiting for extended period of time.
-FPS drop when activating overriding mode.
-Overridden recording not saving correctly to history.
-Playback session still plays while game is paused.
-Particle markers not spawning in the correct location.
